content.intro: The following people or organizations may receive and use your study information:

authorized_texts: A federal law, called the Genetic Information Nondiscrimination Act (GINA), generally makes it illegal for health insurance companies, group health plans, and most employers to discriminate against you based on your genetic information.

Health insurance companies and group health plans may not request genetic information obtained from this research or use it when making decisions about eligibility or premiums. Employers with 15 or more employees may not use genetic information obtained from this research when making employment decisions or setting terms of employment.
GINA does not protect against genetic discrimination by companies that sell life insurance, disability insurance, or long-term care insurance.
